script_text: Stop, Cancer, the cosmos is violently shaking your very foundation right now! Mars is forming a tense square to your ruling planet, the Moon, creating intense friction in your 7th House of Partnerships. Your Water element is feeling the harsh, unforgiving heat of this Fire clash, pushing you toward a major emotional confrontation. If you are currently taken, this aspect demands you address unresolved arguments before sunset; if single, a magnetic but volatile stranger is rapidly approaching your path. In your 10th House of Career, this transit forces a bold power shift, meaning a lucrative promotion is on the line but requires aggressive and highly strategic negotiation to secure your future. Avoid signing any legal documents today, as a hidden clause will ultimately sabotage your financial stability. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see exactly how the stars recover this momentum for you.
